verses.en: O God, my heart is fixed; I will sing and give praise, even with my glory.
verses.pt: Preparado está meu coração, ó Deus; cantarei e tocarei música com minha glória.
verses.en_web: My heart is steadfast, God. I will sing and I will make music with my soul.
verses.en_bbe: <A Song. A Psalm. Of David.> O God, my heart is fixed; I will make songs and melody, even with my glory.

verses.en: Awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.
verses.pt: Desperta-te, lira e harpa; eu despertarei ao amanhecer.
verses.en_web: Wake up, harp and lyre! I will wake up the dawn.
verses.en_bbe: Give out your sounds, O corded instruments: the dawn will be awaking with my song.

verses.en: I will praise thee, O LORD, among the people: and I will sing praises unto thee among the nations.
verses.pt: Louvarei a ti entre os povos, SENHOR, e tocarei música a ti entre as nações;
verses.en_web: I will give thanks to you, Yahweh, among the nations. I will sing praises to you among the peoples.
verses.en_bbe: I will give you praise, O Lord, among the peoples; I will make melody to you among the nations.

verses.en: For thy mercy is great above the heavens: and thy truth reacheth unto the clouds.
verses.pt: Porque tua bondade é maior que os céus, e tua fidelidade mais alta que as nuvens.
verses.en_web: For your loving kindness is great above the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.
verses.en_bbe: For your mercy is higher than the heavens: and your unchanging faith than the clouds.

verses.en: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: and thy glory above all the earth;
verses.pt: Exalta-te sobre os céus, ó Deus; e tua glória sobre toda a terra;
verses.en_web: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be over all the earth.
verses.en_bbe: Be lifted up, O God, higher than the heavens; let your glory be over all the earth.

verses.en: That thy beloved may be delivered: save with thy right hand, and answer me.
verses.pt: Para que teus amados sejam libertados; salva -nos com tua mão direita, e responde-me.
verses.en_web: That your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.
verses.en_bbe: Let your right hand be stretched out for salvation, and give me an answer, so that your loved ones may be safe from danger.

verses.en: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
verses.pt: Deus falou em seu santuário: Eu me alegrarei; repartirei a Siquém, e medirei ao vale de Sucote.
verses.en_web: God has spoken from his sanctuary: “In triumph, I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.
verses.en_bbe: This is the word of the holy God: I will be glad; I will make Shechem a heritage, measuring out the valley of Succoth.

verses.en: Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver;
verses.pt: Meu é Gileade, meu é Manassés; e Efraim é a fortaleza de minha cabeça; Judá é meu legislador.
verses.en_web: Gilead is mine. Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is my helmet. Judah is my scepter.
verses.en_bbe: Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim is the strength of my head; Judah is my law-giver;

verses.en: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe; over Philistia will I triumph.
verses.pt: Moabe é minha bacia de lavar; sobre Edom lançarei meu sapato; sobre a Filístia eu triunfarei.
verses.en_web: Moab is my wash pot. I will toss my sandal on Edom. I will shout over Philistia.”
verses.en_bbe: Moab is my washpot; on Edom is the resting-place of my shoe; over Philistia will I send out a glad cry.

verses.en: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?
verses.pt: Quem me levará a uma cidade fortificada? Quem me guiará até Edom?
verses.en_web: Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who has led me to Edom?
verses.en_bbe: Who will take me into the strong town? who will be my guide into Edom?

verses.en: Wilt not thou, O God, who hast cast us off? and wilt not thou, O God, go forth with our hosts?
verses.pt: Por acaso não serás tu, ó Deus? Tu que tinha nos rejeitado, e não saías mais com nossos exércitos?
verses.en_web: Haven’t you rejected us, God? You don’t go out, God, with our armies.
verses.en_bbe: Have you not sent us away from you, O God? and you go not out with our armies.

verses.en: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.
verses.pt: Dá-nos ajuda para livrarmos da angústia, porque o socorro humano é inútil.
verses.en_web: Give us help against the enemy, for the help of man is vain.
verses.en_bbe: Give us help in our trouble; for there is no help in man.

verses.en: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.
verses.pt: Em Deus faremos proezas; e ele pisoteará nossos adversários. Salmo de Davi, para o regente:
verses.en_web: Through God, we will do valiantly. For it is he who will tread down our enemies.
verses.en_bbe: With God we will do great things; for by him will our haters be crushed underfoot.
